name: standing isometric biceps hold
description: A static curl hold where you keep the elbows bent and the biceps working without moving.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and your elbows at your sides.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees with palms facing up.
Squeeze your fists and flex your biceps hard.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and elbows pinned, then rest and repeat.
